  4. Use the reverse mode to identify an unknown wire from a caliper measurement.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is AWG?

American Wire Gauge is a logarithmic wire-size standard: larger AWG numbers mean thinner wire. Each 3-gauge step halves the cross-section area.

How is diameter computed from AWG?

With the standard formula d = 0.005 × 92^((36−n)/39) inches, then converted to millimetres. Cross-section follows from π·d²/4.

How is resistance per km computed?

From R = ρ·L/A with annealed copper resistivity ρ = 1.68×10⁻⁸ Ω·m at 20 °C. Real installations run slightly higher due to temperature and stranding.
